verdict.line: You lose if you extend trades against his W wall after level 3 or let his Q grave-dig heal him through skirmishes; you win by forcing all-ins with Q stun into double W before he has that tool online.

brief.thesis: Volibear holds a real head-to-head edge here (62.2% win rate over 111 games, versus a flat 48.7% baseline for the matchup in general), because his burst all-in — Q stun into a double W — closes fights faster than Yorick's one-target sustain loop can answer. The entire swing point is Yorick's W: before level 3 he has no space-control tool, so your aggression is close to unanswered, but once Dark Procession is up, getting walled in against his E slow and Mist Walkers is the one sequence that flips the trade.

theirWindow.what: From level 3 on, Yorick can drop W (Dark Procession, range 600) to trap you against terrain, then land E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow while Mist Walkers pile on autos. Don't commit to extended trades against a wall-able surface once he has that point.

yourWindow.when: Levels 1-2, before his W is live
yourWindow.what: Volibear's solo-kill advantage is highest here — walk up and land Q (Thundering Smash, cooldown 12-10s, range 300) for the stun, then double-tap W (Frenzied Maul, cooldown 5s) on the same target for the bonus damage and self-heal before Yorick has any way to control space.

start.why: Highest-performing start in this matchup (63.1% win rate over 103 games, 75.7% pick); the extra sustain from the paired Health Potions matters since Yorick's Q (Last Rites) gives him a self-heal of his own in every exchange.

boots.why: Best-performing boots here (58.8% win rate over 68 games, 53.1% pick) — Yorick's empowered Q auto and Mist Walker autos are all repeated physical hits, which Steelcaps directly blunts.

core.why: First item in the highest-win-rate core path measured (75% over 8 games); gives you the stats to keep winning the stun-into-double-W trade.
Second item in that same path; the attack speed scales your Frenzied Maul double-tap and passive proc damage.
Closes out the core path and offsets the sustain race, since Yorick's Q and Maiden interactions are built around him healing through fights.

situational.when: he's leaning on empowered Q autos and Mist Walker swarms to whittle you down instead of fighting you directly
you need extra poke and sustain to keep pace in longer skirmishes rather than committing to short burst trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in both top rune pages for this matchup — the ramping attack speed rewards exactly the extended stun-into-double-W trades that define your early advantage.

summoners.why: By far the dominant pick for this matchup (60.8% win rate, 84.5% pick rate) — Ignite denies the healing Yorick gets off Q (Last Rites) and closes out skirmishes before he can sustain back up.

playing.title: Trade with Q into double W
playing.detail: Land Q (Thundering Smash, cooldown 12-10s, range 300) for the stun, then cast W (Frenzied Maul, cooldown 5s) twice on the same target — the second cast deals bonus damage and heals you. This wins early all-ins outright.

playing.title: Zone with E before he can wall
playing.detail: Use E (Sky Splitter, cooldown 16s, range 1200) to slow and poke Yorick while he's committed to last-hitting; stand inside the blast radius to pick up the shield if he tries to trade back.

playing.title: Respect the wall from level 3 on
playing.detail: Once Yorick has W (Dark Procession, cooldown 20-12s, range 600), don't fight next to terrain he can wall off — he'll trap you in, follow with E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, and let Mist Walkers swarm.

playing.title: Force him to commit for his Q
playing.detail: Last Rites (cooldown 6-4s) only heals Yorick and digs a grave if it lands on a champion or kills something — contest his trades so he has to walk into your Q's 300 range to get that empowered auto off.

playing.title: Hold E for engage or disengage, not chip poke
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's shield only procs if you're standing in your own blast, so save it for confirming an all-in or breaking off a bad fight rather than spending it on random poke.

playing.title: Ignite to shut off his sustain loop
playing.detail: Flash+Ignite denies the healing from Q (Last Rites) during skirmishes, letting your stun-into-double-W combo close fights before he can heal back to safety.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 62.2% win-rate figure over 111 games come from measured Volibear vs. Yorick data on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability mechanics and wall/stun timing reasoning are my own read of the live kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick during early game to gain lane control. Use [E] to contest lane and, after reaching level 3, be careful of being trapped inside (W).
